build_gemini_request: build a Gemini API request from OpenAI-format messages with tool calls and system instructions
translate_gemini_response: translate a Gemini API response into OpenAI-compatible ChatCompletion format with tool calls and usage metadata
translate_stream_event: translate a Gemini streaming SSE event into OpenAI-compatible delta chunks with parallel tool call indices
wrap_code_assist_request: wrap an inner Gemini request in a Code Assist envelope with project ID and model selection
gemini_http_error: parse a Google HTTP error response into a structured CodeAssistError with status code and retry-after
parse_refresh_parts: parse a packed refresh token string into its refresh token, project ID, and managed project ID components
save_and_load_credentials: save and load Google OAuth credentials to disk with packed refresh format and secure file permissions
get_valid_access_token: get a valid Google OAuth access token, refreshing it automatically if near expiry or clearing on invalid_grant
load_code_assist: load Google Code Assist configuration including tier info and companion project from the API
onboard_user: onboard a user to Google Code Assist with LRO polling for long-running operations
retrieve_user_quota: retrieve per-model usage quota buckets for a Google Cloud project
resolve_project_context: resolve the active Google Cloud project context from config, environment variables, or API discovery
run_gemini_oauth_login_pure: run a headless Gemini OAuth login flow and return credentials as a pool-compatible dictionary
get_auth_status: check whether the user is logged in to Google OAuth and return email and project info
resolve_runtime_provider: resolve a runtime provider configuration dict for the google-gemini-cli provider when logged in
